rules.statement: In a partition action, the original owner need not necessarily be the very first owner and infirmities in claiming an original owner are often overlooked by courts.
rules.supporting_quote: "Therefore in actual practice it is the usual, and in my view sensible, attitude of the Courts that it would not be reasonable to expect proof within very high degrees of probability on questions such as those relating to the original ownership of land. Courts by and large countenance infirmities in this regard"
